key_insight: EHR-Complex is a large interactive benchmark that tests whether clinical agents can reason over real-world EHRs, not just generate static SQL.
clinical_relevance: It highlights the challenge of building reliable AI tools for complex patient and population-level EHR analysis in clinical research workflows.
method: Built on MIMIC-IV with 365K patients, 31 tables, and 500M+ records
Includes ~52K tasks across six clinical intents
Requires interactive execution via SQL queries or Python code in a sandboxed environment
evidence_signal: The benchmark's top model reached only 62.3% exact-match accuracy, and pass@k consistency fell below 50% for nearly all models at k=4.
watch_item: Performance may not translate directly to real clinical deployment because the benchmark still uses a sandboxed environment rather than live EHR systems.
paper_title: EHR-Complex: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Complex Clinical Reasoning
